The firm operates in two divisions, McKesson Distribution Solutions and McKesson Technology Solutions. It has a 6.6 P/E ratio. The McKesson Distribution Solutions segment distributes branded and generic pharmaceutical drugs, and other healthcare-related products; and provides practice management, technology, clinical support, and business solutions to community oncology and other specialty practices.
